attributes.name: compact

attributes.name: inverted

attributes.name: floating

attributes.name: compact

tokens.description: The colour, by scheme:  `light-dark()` of its two bases.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-inverted
tokens.description: The colour on dark surfaces, whatever the scheme.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-on
tokens.description: Text ON the solid colour:  white or ink, picked by contrast.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-inverted-on
tokens.description: Text on the `-inverted` colour.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-hover
tokens.description: Hover state, derived from the colour.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-focus
tokens.description: Focus state, derived from the colour.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-down
tokens.description: Pressed state, derived from the colour.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-active
tokens.description: Active (selected) state, derived from the colour.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-text
tokens.default: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-positive) 0.46 calc(c * 0.6) h), oklch(from var(--ui-positive) 0.85 calc(c * 0.6) h) )
tokens.description: Text in this colour:  4.5:1 on `--ui-background`, per scheme.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-header
tokens.default: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-positive) 0.4 calc(c * 0.6) h), oklch(from var(--ui-positive) 0.9 calc(c * 0.5) h) )
tokens.description: Headers in this colour:  a shade darker than `-text`.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-border
tokens.default: light-dark( oklch(from var(--ui-positive) 0.8 calc(c * 0.3) h), oklch(from var(--ui-positive) 0.45 calc(c * 0.4) h) )
tokens.description: Borders in this colour.

tokens.name: --ui-positive-background

tokens.description: Pale tinted background (`ui-bg-*`, messages).
